findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: A container of cooked chicken wings and French fries were stored in close proximity of the handwashing sink. Discussed moving the food items to a different location to prevent contamination. Ensure that food is stored in a manner that protects against contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Observed a leak at the handwashing sink. PIC mentioned that the facility is working to repair the leaking pipe. Ensure that pipes are maintained in good repair and never leaking.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: Inspector observed chicken over fish in the 2 door cooler in the cook area and chicken over shredded cabbage in the walk in cooler. The chicken was moved down to a proper storage place in the 2 door cooler and cabbage was moved to the vegetable side in the walk in cooler. Take care to properly protect food in the cold holding units. The violation is considered corrected on site.

(A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Inspector observed chlorine to be at approximately 10ppm in the sanitizer bucket. The bucket was remade to have 100ppm of chlorine. The violation is considered corrected on site. Take care to change buckets or test them regularly to know when to change them in order to maintain proper sanitizer concentration. 

Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: Inspector observed some foods in the top of the make table to be between 47F and 50F. The Unit has been open for the last two hours during lunch and the foods are stacked high in the pans. More than a dozen hot dogs and 12 pizza puffs were discarded. The violation is considered corrected on site. Ensure that the unit is being used in a way that does not allow food temperatures to rise above 41F.

(A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
Priority and priority foundation items were present during the insepciton.

2-102.11: Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, PIC shall demonstrate knowledge by:  (A) Having no Priority Foundation items; (B) Being a CFM; OR (C) Responding correctly questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include C1 through C16.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Employee washed hands and did not use a barrier to turn off the faucet. The employee was redirected to hand sink, coached on proper hand washing and washed his hands correctly. Violation is considered corrected on site. Maintain good hand washing practices. 

2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
A cone of frozen gyro meat is observed in the chest freezer with a thank you bag covering it. Also, the freezer holding french fries has a random cardboard box with frozen garlic bread in it. The garlic bread was moved to an aluminum pan. Use only smooth, cleanable, food quality containers to hold or cover food. Facility removed bag and used aluminum foil to cover the cone. The violations are considered corrected on site. 
Also, the bucket of pickles is heavily soiled on the lid and sides. Clean and maintain clean.
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Foods in the top and bottom of the prep cooler/make table are between 50F and 55F. Foods that were cooked at open and put into the prep table warm were moved to the walk in cooler (chicken tenders, gyro meat). Foods that were frozen and put into the table this morning were moved to the walk in as well (pre portioned burger patties and steak-ums). All other foods were voluntarily discarded in the garbage. Foods included cheese slices, shredded cheese, cut tomato, cooked onions, cooked green peppers, shrimp and all other prepared foods. The violation is considered corrected. Do not use this cooler for food until it is repaired or replaced. 

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
The only make table (sandwich prep cooler) is not holding food at 41F or below. Have the cooler repaired or replace the cooler. Do not use the unit until it is repaired.

4-301.11: EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the wall behind the hand sink in the employee restroom to be in disrepair and not longer cleanable. Repair the wall.

6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface.
